places.raw_name: brushy country several miles from the Nueces
places.name: Stampede ground south of the Nueces
places.note: A night sandstorm then lightning and drenching rain stampede the herd into mesquite thickets; Newt ends lost and soaked, plodding on Mouse.
places.location_hint: mesquite and chaparral brush country, several miles south of the Nueces River crossing; herd scattered northward in the dark

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Several miles ahead; Deets advises against trying its steep crossing in the dark before the storm.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call recalls sitting out many such south winds there, sand stinging like birdshot.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Sand storms blew up from there; Newt remembers the welcome dawn after their night raid into it.
